# Named Routes

> Type-safe routes, URLs and public assets for seven frameworks. Documentation version 2.2.0.

Read the agent contract first. Always check the installed version and generated route names. Named Routes builds URLs; it does not replace framework routers or perform HTTP requests.

## Essential context

- [Agent contract](llms-agent.md): conventions, imports, base paths, framework integration, API boundaries and safety.
- [Full English reference](llms-full.txt): complete offline-readable guide including examples.
